candidate_axiom.name: Recursive Meta-Refutation & Heuristic Half-Life Decay
candidate_axiom.statement: Every active epistemic search heuristic must maintain an empirical half-life based on its marginal contribution to structural candidate discovery; heuristics whose rolling yield falls below replacement entropy are dynamically discounted and subjected to recursive meta-refutation.
candidate_axiom.operational_rule: Search rules that fail to yield compilable structural axioms within a moving window lose generative priority.

system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Active Heuristic Registry] ──> [Yield Attribution Tracker]
                                            │
                                            ▼
                                [Half-Life Decay Engine]
                                            │
                                            ▼
                                [Meta-Refutation Deprecator]

Yield Attribution Tracker.role: Traces downstream structural successes back to the guiding epistemic heuristics.
Yield Attribution Tracker.invariant_rule: Every committed structural delta updates heuristic credit scores.

Half-Life Decay Engine.role: Applies continuous exponential time-decay to inactive heuristic weights.
Half-Life Decay Engine.invariant_rule: Heuristics without recent yield suffer monotonic prompt de-weighting.

Meta-Refutation Deprecator.role: Permanently prunes stagnant search heuristics from the meta-prompt before Phase 2.
Meta-Refutation Deprecator.invariant_rule: Frees prompt context space for high-performing generators.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Prunes worn-out search directions, keeping prompt context lean and focused (+0.0100).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Maintains high refutation throughput by discarding indecisive search rules (+0.0170).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Maximizes structural yield by allocating compute only to proven generators (+0.0150).

tradeoffs.strengths: Prevents prompt context bloat; actively optimizes the meta-compiler's own cognition.
tradeoffs.constraints: May prematurely discount slow-burn heuristics if decay parameter tau is set too short.

system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Candidate Axiom] ──> [Stochastic Chaos Engine]
                              │
                              ▼
                 [Perturbed Target Sandbox]
                              │
                              ▼
                 [Convexity & Fragility Auditor] ──> [Hardened Invariant]

Stochastic Chaos Engine.role: Injects network jitter, corrupted RPC messages, and resource starvation during simulation.
Stochastic Chaos Engine.invariant_rule: Perturbations must be bounded to preserve simulation decidability.

Convexity Auditor.role: Measures second derivative of system stability with respect to disturbance magnitude.
Convexity Auditor.invariant_rule: Rejects candidates showing brittle, cliff-edge failure modes.

Self-Healing Reconfigurer.role: Tests candidate architecture's ability to autonomously re-converge after stress.
Self-Healing Reconfigurer.invariant_rule: Recovery to coherent state must occur within finite simulation depth.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Forces exploration towards robust, decentralized consensus invariants (+0.0130).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Unmasks brittle and overfitted candidates in a single perturbation pass (+0.0140).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Produces structural axioms that operate reliably in Byzantine environments (+0.0110).

tradeoffs.strengths: Guarantees high real-world robustness; eliminates fragile happy-path architectures.
tradeoffs.constraints: Consumes higher compute token budget per simulation pass due to Monte Carlo noise injection.

leaderboard.name: Ergodic State Exploration & Measure-Preserving Search Dynamics
leaderboard.statement: The hypothesis generation mechanism must operate as an ergodic dynamical system over the manifold of architectural topologies, guaranteeing that time averages of candidate trajectories converge to space averages over reachable configuration space, precluding deadlocks and local attractors.
leaderboard.operational_rule: Search generators that fall into repetitive topological attractors are penalized with negative exploratory momentum.
leaderboard.domain: Statistical Mechanics & Ergodic Theory (Ludwig Boltzmann & George Birkhoff)

                                           │
                                           ▼
                                [Anti-Attractor Repulsor]
                                           │
                                           ▼
                                [Ergodic Generator Dispatch]

Density Manifold Estimator.role: Maps past candidate axioms to an abstract topological coordinate manifold.
Density Manifold Estimator.invariant_rule: Maintains a spatial probability density of explored conceptual regions.

Anti-Attractor Repulsor.role: Computes repulsive vector fields around dense clusters to push generators away from local minima.
Anti-Attractor Repulsor.invariant_rule: Forces distance metric d(new, history) > threshold.

Ergodic Dispatcher.role: Allocates candidate generation quotas across unvisited conceptual quadrants.
Ergodic Dispatcher.invariant_rule: Guarantees non-zero sampling probability for all valid mathematical paradigms.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Maximum diversity gain; completely eliminates conceptual clustering and model collapse (+0.0190).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Avoids redundant verification of near-identical hypotheses (+0.0080).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Unearths orthogonal structural paradigms that standard heuristics overlook (+0.0100).

tradeoffs.strengths: Total immunity to mode collapse; broad discovery across unconventional disciplines.
tradeoffs.constraints: Higher initial variance in candidate compilation success due to radical exploration jumps.
